# Getting help

- Start with the [manual](https://docs.openbacktesting.com/), [quickstart](https://docs.openbacktesting.com/quickstart/), and [examples](https://docs.openbacktesting.com/examples/).
- Use [Discussions](https://github.com/lucidcog/openbacktesting/discussions) for installation questions, strategy research, and sharing examples.
- Use [Issues](https://github.com/lucidcog/openbacktesting/issues/new/choose) for reproducible bugs, feature proposals, and documentation corrections.
- Report potential vulnerabilities using the private channel in [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md).

Include the core and Studio versions or commit, Python version, operating system, relevant settings, and a minimal example. Use synthetic or redistributable data; remove credentials, session tokens, private paths, and confidential datasets. Only share strategy code you have permission to publish.

For contributions, see [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md). Community support is provided as maintainers and contributors are available; no response time is guaranteed.
